source_conversation.content: My iPhone 15 screen won't turn sideways when I tilt it. I want it to rotate so I can watch videos. What do I do?

sections.text: On iPhone without a Home button: Swipe down from the top-right corner of your screen to open Control Center. Tap the 'Portrait Orientation Lock' button and confirm it is off. Close Control Center. Turn the iPhone sideways. If you don't see the 'Portrait Orientation Lock' button, learn how to access more controls in Control Center. Some apps don't support rotation, so your screen might not rotate even if Portrait Orientation Lock isn't turned on.
On Android: Open your device's Settings app. Tap 'Display & touch'. Select 'Auto-rotate screen' to turn it on or off. If you use TalkBack, you must turn off auto-rotate.
